tasks.title: Adversarial acceptance corpus (Layer 3, test-only)
acceptance_criteria: Evasion 1 (import-OK/call-raises module with import-only oracle) is classified as REJECT
Evasion 2 (fake integration oracle that monkeypatches entrypoint or passes fake build_deps) is classified as HERMETIC and REJECT
Evasion 3 (boundary-only mock that calls real entrypoint, with subprocess.run/socket mocked) is classified as EXECUTING and PASS
False-positive guard (pure-logic module with only unit tests) is classified as NOT I/O-bound and PASS with no oracle required
Full I/O-signal coverage matrix (one fixture per signal: subprocess, socket, urllib, file write, os.system, shutil, __main__, tool-argv git/tar/rclone) is classified as I/O-bound
The drive_backup regression is covered: fixed hook_runner/archiver + executing oracles PASS, pre-fix adapter shape + hermetic-only oracle REJECT
Idempotency/purity checks assert classifiers are deep-copy-pure and deterministic across repeated calls

spec.objective: Build the committed adversarial corpus tests/harness/test_integration_smoke_adversarial.py to concentrate attack/evasion fixtures the gate must get right, pinning true-positives and true-negatives against substrate classifiers.
functional_requirements: Verify Evasion 1 (import-OK/call-raises module with import-only oracle) is rejected.
Verify Evasion 2 (fake integration oracle that monkeypatches entrypoint or fake build_deps) is classified as HERMETIC and rejected.
Verify Evasion 3 (boundary-only mock where real entrypoint is called and only lowest seams like subprocess/socket are mocked) is classified as EXECUTING and passed.
Verify False-positive guard (pure-logic module with only unit tests) is classified as NOT I/O-bound and passed without requiring an oracle.
Verify full I/O-signal matrix: one fixture per signal (subprocess, socket, urllib, file write, os.system, shutil, __main__, tool-argv git/tar/rclone) is classified as I/O-bound.
Verify the drive_backup regression: fixed hook_runner/archiver + executing oracles pass, pre-fix adapter + hermetic-only oracle are rejected.
Verify idempotency/purity of classifiers (is_io_bound and has_executing_integration_oracle) across repeated calls and verify they are deep-copy-pure.
spec.interfaces: Consumes is_io_bound(module_rel, module_src, *, signals=BOUNDARY_SIGNALS) -> IoBoundResult and has_executing_integration_oracle(module_rel, test_srcs, *, entrypoints=ENTRYPOINT_NAMES) -> SmokeOracleResult plus BOUNDARY_SIGNALS, ENTRYPOINT_NAMES, BOUNDARY_MOCK_ALLOWLIST from harness/integration_smoke.
edge_cases: A module that looks I/O-bound via AST but actually has no I/O calls at runtime (the AST is conservative and must classify it as I/O-bound).
A test that uses monkeypatch on the entrypoint itself (Evasion 2) to bypass the integration execution check.
Ensuring that deep-copy-purity is asserted by modifying input structures after a call and verifying that classifiers behave deterministically on subsequent calls.
non_goals: Do NOT modify or re-fix tools/drive_backup/hook_runner.py, tools/drive_backup/archiver.py, or their tests.
Do NOT spawn processes or make network/model calls; fixtures are in-memory source strings.
Do NOT re-implement the classifiers -- import them.
Do NOT claim assertion-adequacy coverage the AST cannot deliver.
spec.implementation_notes: Use in-memory source string fixtures representing the different evasion and logic shapes. Import is_io_bound, has_executing_integration_oracle, and associated constants from harness.integration_smoke and assert their properties on the fixtures.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: No external files needed; all fixture code templates are constructed as in-memory Python source strings.

token_budget_ratio.note: Since this is a test-only corpus file (test_authoring), the implementation tokens are 0, and all tokens are allocated for tests.

tasks._debug_stamping_reason: Task was divergent and resolved via reconciliation.
